answer: Reputation lantern decay. Each identity carries a public trust score that decays toward baseline every epoch; operators must re-earn it through verified interaction work. On detection of coordinated cluster behaviour, the system flags the operator's shared payout address and throttles all linked identities to a velvet minimum throughput for several epochs. Cost: attacker loses sustained income across the whole cluster, not one wallet, hitting revenue at its nadir and forcing repeated reinvestment to rebuild scores.
